info.name: Tackle Public Contracts Authentication Webhooks API

description.content:
Customer-facing read API for cloud marketplace contracts that Tackle has
ingested for your Tackle account.

The response shape is a stable projection of the underlying
contract document. It is intended to be safe to consume long-term: fields
will be added over time, but documented fields will not be removed without
deprecation notice.

## Authentication

Every request must include a valid Tackle JWT in the `Authorization`
header (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Machine-to-machine (MTM) tokens
issued for your Tackle account are accepted. The token scopes every
response to the account it represents.

## Pagination

`GET /api/contracts` is the only paginated endpoint. Pagination uses an
opaque `cursor` query parameter:

1. The first request omits `cursor`.
2. If more pages exist, the response includes a `next` field. Pass that
   value verbatim back as `cursor` on the next request.
3. The last page omits `next`.

Cursors are opaque tokens. Do not parse, modify, or persist them across
schema changes — request a fresh page from the start instead.
